port.ask: Serial port the 650 controller appears on (COM3, /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/tty.usbserial-*)
port.help: The controller's RS-232 socket (the one Spin 3000 uses) through a straight cable to a USB-serial adapter, or its USB port with Laurell's driver. Baud and framing are placeholders until Laurell's command document is in hand.
